text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Tokai Teio and Mejiro 
McQueen sneaking around, hiding in the 
shade of the trees.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi! Come on, let's keep watching! 
Since they're talking about our good 
points and all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... Eavesdropping of all things... 
Just a little bit, all right? Just a 
little!

Looking over in the direction they were 
watching...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, Teio-san's last spurt is way 
cooler!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san is much more graceful and full 
of elegance! Even her demeanor is just so, 
like, dazzling—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, you two. Are you arguing about 
Teio versus McQueen again?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Nature-san! And—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Is this a discussion regarding those two? 
If so, I have several pieces of 
information stockpiled.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo too! Turbo knows things too~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, looks like the info squad is all 
gathered. How about we unveil our best 
material!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I heard this from Mayano, but... 
apparently when McQueen was feeling under 
the weather, Teio anonymously sent her 
honey, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that McQueen-san owns footage 
of every single race Teio-san has entered, 
and studies her running form.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Oh! Speaking of which, in order to 
understand McQueen better, Teio once spent 
an entire day talking like her.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There are also rumors that, as part of her 
research into Teio-san, McQueen-san once 
attempted to infiltrate the Student 
Council room.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then Turbo gets to talk last! Those two, 
you see, actually ◎※★△—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: STOOOOOP!! That's enoughーー!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How dare you spout such baseless 
fabrications!? ...N-Not that I am saying 
every single bit is false, though!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, if it isn't the two stars. 
Don't tell me you were eavesdropping on 
us~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they were eavesdropping♪ They were 
totally listening in~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Geez! It is all because Teio-san suggested 
we listen in...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Say what you want, McQueen, but you were 
totally into it too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is always like this with you! Running 
off on your own and dragging others 
along...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't force you to do anything! If 
you've got a problem with it, want to 
settle things right here and now?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a fight? A race? If it's a race, 
Turbo wants in too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If we are to settle this, let 
it be in a race...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Is what I would like to say, but... We 
have a photo shoot coming up after this...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then do something quick! If it's something 
quick... Rock-Paper-Scissors!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Rock-paper-scissors, huh... 
Rock-paper-scissors is...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Kinda... lame..

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well... yes. On that point, I find myself 
in agreement desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whyyy?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because when I compete with McQueen, I 
don't want to leave it up to luck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If I am to challenge Teio-san, I wish to 
win purely through my own ability desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Power, power, power... If it's a power 
match, arm wrestling?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that works! We can settle it quickly 
with pure strength!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yikes. I really don't want the 
underclassmen to witness such a childish 
dispute, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there someone around who could get 
this situation under control—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, perfect timing, Trainer! Could you 
step in between these two?
choice_data_list: Save the important match for later

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An important match... Certainly, that is 
true, but...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, didn't you mention something about 
a photo shoot earlier? Is that okay to 
skip?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, the shoot...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, we must hurry! If we run now, we 
can still make it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...! Bye-bye, everyone!!

With that, the two dashed off 
side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Is it true that you broke into the 
Student Council room?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! What about you, Teio-san, 
did you really imitate the way I talk...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Say what you will, those two really get 
along well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... they sure do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, now we can have our match 
without any reservations! Here I go!

Afterwards, their strength proved to be 
evenly matched, and the contest dragged 
on, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You two!! When you didn't show up for the 
photo shoot, I wondered what you were up 
to, only to find this...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!? The photo shoot... Ahhh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What a dreadful mistake... I completely 
forgot about it...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Reflect on your actions later! The 
President and the others have been waiting 
long enough! Let's go!

And so, Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen were 
dragged away by the scruff of their 
necks...
